[pause 0.45] Or choose all twelve leads, and watch every one sweep live. [pause 0.6] Sinus bradycardia, forty-eight a minute. [pause 0.35] Slow and regular, with a P wave before every Q-R-S, in every lead. [pause 0.6] Now the instructor changes the rhythm. [pause 1.0] Sinus tachycardia at one hundred and eight, with an anterior STEM-ee. [pause 0.6] S-T elevation in V one to V four, and in one and A-V-L. [pause 0.6] Now look at three and A-V-F.
